Paragraph: "Then Hanuma, the ablest sentence-maker, said this sentence to Sugreeva who is dismayed with fear doubting Vali's mischief..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Sugreeva remains trapped in irrational fear of Vali's treachery.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma, skilled in articulate communication, steps forward to intervene verbally.
Outcome/Resolution: He prepares to offer grounded, rational counsel to his anxious king.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Vakya-Kushalatva (Mastery in speech used to calm mind-disturbances in others)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The divine servant (Hanuma) uses clear speech to free the soul from paranoid doubts.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Therapeutic communication: leveraging articulate speech and calm presence to ground an anxious individual.
